title: Mexican Smoky Ploughmans
description: A unique twist on the traditional ploughman's with smoky flavors and mexican inspiration.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill the sliced chorizo until slightly charred, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Slice the morbier cheese into thin wedges.
Assemble the tacos by placing a few slices of chorizo onto a tortilla, followed by a slice of morbier cheese, a few slices of apple, and a sprinkle of coriander.
Drizzle with a squeeze of lime juice and a sprinkle of mexican street corn seasoning.
Optional: Top with sliced ploughmans cheese and a drizzle of olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
